questions.prompt: Which open range is widest at the same 100bb stack?
questions.explanation: Fewer opponents and position make the heads-up button the widest open.

questions.prompt: Folded to the button with A5s. What is the mistake?

choices.text: Folding because the ace is not suited to a broadway card
Taking a flop in position when called

questions.explanation: Suited aces are standard button opens. They are not under-the-gun trash.

questions.prompt: The game just dropped from 9-handed to 5-handed. Your unopened range should…

choices.text: Stay frozen at the 9-handed UTG chart.
Widen, because each seat is later relative to a full ring.
Become all-in or fold with no opens.

questions.explanation: Player count changes position. Five-handed opens are wider than full-ring opens from the same seat name.

questions.prompt: Cutoff opens, and you are on the button with 100bb and JTo. Calling can be fine. What is the clear mistake?

choices.text: Calling a single 3bb open in position
Folding if a third player squeezes large
Preferring a call over an all-in

questions.explanation: JTo can take a flop in position. Stacking off 100bb preflop with it is not a value jam.
